categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Aidea Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: anti-HIV pharmaceutical products and human-derived protein products. The company focuses on innovative drug development and commercialization in the HIV treatment field, including proprietary new drugs and high-end generic drugs. Additionally, it has a vertically integrated business in human-derived protein raw materials and formulations, including urokinase and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced resin adsorption technology for efficient extraction and purification of human-derived proteins from urine, enabling large-scale industrial production with reduced environmental impact. It also employs proprietary chemical synthesis and formulation technologies for small molecule anti-HIV drugs, including novel non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors and integrase inhibitors. The company maintains GMP-compliant production facilities and has developed patented processes for raw material purification and drug formulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical formulation companies purchasing human-derived protein raw materials, hospitals, and healthcare providers for anti-HIV drugs, and medical institutions for diagnostic reagents. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and is expanding into international markets, particularly in Africa and Southeast Asia. Its products target HIV-infected patients, patients requiring thrombolytic therapy, and other clinical indications such as stroke and inflammation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yangzhou and Nanjing. It has begun expanding its commercial and registration activities internationally, focusing on African countries like Tanzania (Zanzibar) and Nigeria, as well as Southeast Asian markets. The company holds GMP certification for export and has established strategic partnerships with overseas pharmaceutical firms.
categories.supply_chain_position: Aidea Pharma operates across multiple points in the pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream raw material extraction (human urine protein extraction), midstream raw material purification and API production, and downstream drug formulation and commercialization. The acquisition of Nanjing Nanda Pharmaceutical enables integrated operations from raw materials to finished formulations, strengthening its vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in anti-HIV therapies, focusing on developing next-generation integrase inhibitors, long-acting HIV prevention drugs, and high-end generic drugs. It also advances human-derived protein drug development, including new indications such as stroke treatment. R&D efforts include clinical trials, patent applications, and real-world evidence studies to support product efficacy and safety. The company aims to expand its product pipeline and enhance commercialization capabilities domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pharmaceutical raw materials, APIs, and finished drug formulations. The company employs direct sales and distribution partnerships for its anti-HIV drugs and human-derived protein products. It also generates income from licensing and technology transfer related to its proprietary drug formulations and manufacturing processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Aidea Pharma is positioned as a leading domestic innovator in the Chinese anti-HIV drug market, competing with both imported branded drugs and domestic generic manufacturers. It holds a first-mover advantage with two approved class 1 new drugs and a broad R&D pipeline. In the human-derived protein sector, it is a market leader with integrated production capabilities. Competitors include multinational pharmaceutical companies and domestic firms specializing in HIV and protein therapeutics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 417.8 million, a slight increase of 1.57% year-over-year. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 141.2 million, reflecting increased R&D and sales expenses. The company’s total assets grew to RMB 1.87 billion, supported by the acquisition of Nanjing Nanda Pharmaceutical. R&D investment increased to 25.73% of revenue, indicating a strong focus on innovation and future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Aidea Pharma emphasizes its dual-core competitive advantage in innovative anti-HIV drugs and human-derived protein products with proprietary technologies and integrated supply chain control. Its anti-HIV drugs offer high efficacy, safety, and convenience with once-daily dosing and favorable side effect profiles, supported by clinical and real-world evidence. The company’s human-derived protein products benefit from patented extraction and purification technologies, ensuring high quality and cost efficiency. Its strategic focus on innovation, vertical integration, and expanding international presence differentiates it in the pharmaceutical industry.
